unknown: The WGS84 locations of the Hero pivot, main entrance center and main-ribbon endpoint.

rejectedPseudoFixes: Road-distance equivalent translations are diagnostic numbers only, not placement candidates; plaza, ribbon and steps require different translations.
Arbitrary registry movement or global scaling would alter both road setbacks and cannot prove the real anchor.
The OSM centroid, a same-address POI, or an unbound layer=1 overlap way provides at most one weak point and cannot solve orientation/origin offset.
The historical Film AABB overlap cannot be used as a current collision blocker or a reason to move Shanghai Cinema; current Film calibration has removed it.
minimumUnblock: An official/site-survey plan with north arrow and scale, correlated to the OSM outline, marking at least two uniquely identifiable points in both WGS84 and the local GLB geometry (for example main entrance center plus a main-ribbon end, or a tower corner).
If scale is not fixed by that plan, include a scale measurement or a third non-collinear point.

Main-window adjudication of whether the solved transform requires registry placement, local-origin correction, footprint revision, or a combination; only then rerun the affected map/collision/runtime gates.
